reference.title: Scenario 10 — 2-column table in an API reference section

section.p: Consider a 2-column table inside a section classified as an API reference topic — for example, a parameter list or API attribute table where the heading contains a keyword such as "API", "parameters", or "reference".

entry.codeblock:
API Parameters

Parameter Description
timeout Request timeout in seconds.
retry_count Number of retry attempts.
log_level Logging verbosity.

<reference id="api_parameters"> <title>API Parameters</title> <refbody> <properties> <prophead> <proptypehd>Parameter</proptypehd> <propvaluehd>Description</propvaluehd> </prophead> <property> <proptype>timeout</proptype> <propvalue>Request timeout in seconds.</propvalue> </property> <property> <proptype>retry_count</proptype> <propvalue>Number of retry attempts.</propvalue> </property> <property> <proptype>log_level</proptype> <propvalue>Logging verbosity.</propvalue> </property> </properties> </refbody> </reference>

section.p: Result: The converter recognises the API reference context from the heading keyword and maps the 2-column <table> to <properties>. For general comparison tables, status tables, or multi-column reference data, the converter maps to <simpletable> or CALS <table> instead.
